company.name: Georgette Packaging
company.shortDescription: Elegant and thoughtful packaging for small businesses and discerning individuals.
company.description:
Georgette Packaging was launched in November 2013.  

My background as a mechanical engineer (McGill '07), the owner of a cupcake bakery in Northern Ireland, and an MBA grad (Ivey '13) has given me a unique interest in the needs of small businesses, and the Canadian manufacturing sector's ability to meet them.  I'm very proud to say that all our products are manufactured in London, Ontario, Canada, my home-town.

They have been lucky enough to be covered by the Globe & Mail (on the subject of young entrepreneurs in traditional businesses, and a second article about MBA entrepreneurs), as well as the London Free Press.
